last.verdict: Moderna swung to a quarterly profit and raised its revenue outlook, but the cash forecast jump comes mostly from borrowing, not operations.

takeaways.label: Profit and higher outlook
takeaways.text: Revenue rose 29% to $1.3B on international COVID vaccine deliveries, giving net income of $162M versus a $200M loss a year ago. Full-year growth is now seen at 15–25%, up from up to 10%.

takeaways.label: Cash boost is borrowed
takeaways.text: Year-end cash is now seen at $8.1–8.3B, up from $4.7–5.2B, largely because of $2.6B net from convertible notes. Most Q3 sales are still uncollected; receivables hit $1.37B.

takeaways.label: Melanoma shot works
takeaways.text: With Merck, intismeran plus Keytruda cut the risk of recurrence or death 42% versus Keytruda alone in Phase 3. Filings are being prepared, and further readouts are expected.

takeaways.label: Flu launch limited
takeaways.text: The flu vaccine mFLUSIVA won U.S. approval, but only a limited launch is planned this season because approval came after contracting. Norovirus has no new cohort this season.

history.verdict: Norovirus vaccine setback outweighed a smaller-than-expected loss and lower costs.

reasons.label: Norovirus vaccine setback
reasons.text: Phase 3 norovirus vaccine missed early-success bar; more patients must be enrolled, delaying it.

reasons.label: Pipeline over numbers
reasons.text: Revenue is only $145M, so the stock trades on upcoming flu and melanoma news.

reasons.label: Cost cuts, cash runway
reasons.text: Spending outlook trimmed about $0.2B; year-end cash now seen at $4.7–5.2B.
